verdict.rationale: Dialpad documents its own AI voice and digital agents that autonomously handle customer conversations, resolve common requests, and hand off to humans, and it lets users design custom voice and digital experiences. That is a narrow form of autonomous, user-configured automation. Webhooks, websocket event subscriptions and the APIs are developer building blocks and earn no credit here. missing for 10: a documented general-purpose automation or workflow builder, triggers or recurring schedules for background tasks, evidence of how users set up and manage automations, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background

citations.quote: AI voice and digital agents that handle customer conversations, resolve common requests, and hand off to human agents with full context.
